# Best apps to transcribe voice memos on iPhone (2026)

Start with the app you already have: on iPhone 12 or later, Apple’s Voice Memos transcribes recordings in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and a few other languages, and Apple Intelligence can summarize the transcript on newer models. Another app helps when you want imported or very long recordings handled the same way, a summary shaped for a lecture or a meeting, more languages, or the same app on Android. This page compares nine options using only what each vendor states on its own pages, checked on October 26, 2026.

## Which apps transcribe voice memos on iPhone?

| App | Platforms | Record on the phone | Import a voice memo or file | AI summary | Languages |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Apple Voice Memos | iPhone, iPad, Mac | Yes, with a live transcript | — | Partly: with Apple Intelligence Writing Tools¹ | English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (iPhone 12 or later) |
| Apple Notes (Record Audio in a note) | iPhone | Yes, with a live transcript | — | Yes, with Apple Intelligence¹ | The same list, when it’s also the device language |
| Otter | iOS, Android, web, desktop (Mac, Windows) | Yes, live | Yes | Yes | A list including English, Spanish and Portuguese (Brazil); you select the language before recording² |
| Notta | iOS, Android, web, desktop (Windows, macOS) | Yes (Record Now) | Yes | Yes | A long list, including English, Spanish and Portuguese |
| Transkriptor | iOS, Android, web, Chrome extension, desktop (Windows, Mac) | Yes | Yes | Yes | A long list, including English, Spanish and Portuguese |
| Transcribe – Speech to Text (DENIVIP · App Store id1241342461) | iPhone, iPad, Mac, web | Yes, with live transcription | Yes | Yes | A long list, including English, Spanish and Portuguese |
| Aiko (Sindre Sorhus) | iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro | Yes | Yes: files and voice memos | — | A long list, including English, Spanish and Portuguese; transcribes on the device |
| TurboScribe | Web, also in the phone’s browser | Partly: in the browser, with the microphone | Yes, by upload | Partly: through TurboScribe GPT (ChatGPT) | A long list, including English, Spanish and Portuguese |
| Verbi | iPhone, Android | Yes, with live transcription | Yes: Upload File, sharing from Voice Memos, WhatsApp or Telegram, and video links | Yes: nine templates that keep to what was said | 39 languages with auto-detect |

— Not stated in the source.

¹ On iOS 27, Apple Intelligence needs an iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max or an iPhone 16 or later. ² Otter’s language list was updated on November 10, 2026; we rechecked Otter on November 19, 2026.

## Can iPhone transcribe voice memos without another app?

Yes, on iPhone 12 or later. Apple’s [iPhone User Guide](https://support.apple.com/en-us/guide/iphone/iph00953a982/ios) (iOS 27) says Voice Memos transcribes speech in English (all variants), Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), and that the feature isn’t available in every country or region. You can watch the transcript while you record, copy it afterwards with Copy Transcript, and search across titles and transcripts. With Apple Intelligence, Writing Tools can summarize a transcript; on iOS 27 that needs an iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max or an iPhone 16 or later.

The Notes app does the same inside a note: tap Record Audio, and according to Apple’s [Notes guide](https://support.apple.com/en-us/guide/iphone/iphbe11247b5/ios) the spoken words are transcribed when the device language is one of those languages, with an Apple Intelligence summary on supported models. If your recordings are in one of these languages and you mainly want to read or copy what was said, the built-in apps may be all you need.

## Otter

Otter (Otter.ai, Inc.) has apps for iPhone and Android, a web app and a [desktop app for Mac and Windows](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/35973988280215-Otter-Desktop-App-Mac-Windows). It records and transcribes live, [imports audio and video files](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047733574-Import-an-audio-or-video-file) and writes [automatic meeting summaries](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/9156381229079-Meeting-Summary-Overview). Its help center’s [language list](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047247414-Supported-Languages), updated on November 10, 2026, includes English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish and others; you [select the spoken language](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/26660468516631-Transcribe-conversations-in-different-languages-with-Otter) before recording or importing, and the app’s menus stay in English (checked November 19, 2026).

A good fit if you work in English or another language on its list and want the same notes on your phone, in the browser and on your computer.

## Notta

Notta runs on iPhone and Android, on the web and as a desktop app for Windows and macOS ([supported environments](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/18119588493467-Supported-environments)). The app’s home screen offers [Import Files, Record Now and Live Transcribe Meetings](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/17604467003803-Introduction-about-Notta-App), its [language list](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/4403155631131-What-languages-does-Notta-support) is long and includes English, Spanish and Portuguese, and its [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/notta-transcribe-voice-to-text/id1480649572) describes AI summaries.

A good fit if you switch between phone and computer and record in several languages.

## Transkriptor

Transkriptor is available for iOS and Android, on the web, as a Chrome extension and as a [desktop app for Windows and Mac](https://transkriptor.com/desktop-app/). Its [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/transkriptor-speech-to-text/id1610386353) describes an integrated audio recorder, voice memo and file transcription (MP3, WAV, M4A), AI summaries and a chat with the transcript, and its [website](https://transkriptor.com/) names English, Spanish and Portuguese among many languages.

A good fit if you also want a browser extension or a desktop recorder for online meetings.

## Transcribe – Speech to Text (DENIVIP)

Transcribe – Speech to Text (DENIVIP Group OOO, App Store id1241342461) works on iPhone, iPad and Mac and in a web editor at [transcribe.com](https://transcribe.com/). Its [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/transcribe-speech-to-text/id1241342461) describes a built-in voice recorder with live transcription, audio and video uploads, speaker separation, and AI summaries and key points, and its [help center](https://transcribe.com/help-center) names English, Spanish and Portuguese among many languages. Other apps have similar names, so check the developer before you download.

A good fit if you work on an iPhone and a Mac and also want to edit transcripts in a browser.

## Aiko

[Aiko](https://sindresorhus.com/aiko), from the independent developer Sindre Sorhus, turns recordings of meetings, lectures and voice memos into text with OpenAI’s Whisper model running on the device; the developer says the audio is never uploaded. It runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro, and its [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aiko/id1672085276) requires iOS 26 or later and an A12 Bionic chip or newer.

A good fit if you want the transcription to stay on your device.

## TurboScribe

TurboScribe is a web app. Its [help page](https://turboscribe.ai/help/does-turboscribe-have-a-mobile-app) says there is no TurboScribe app in the App Store or on Google Play and that the website works fully in a phone’s browser, including uploads, transcription, translation and export. You can [upload a voice memo or record with the microphone](https://turboscribe.ai/u/transcribe-voice-memos) in the browser, its audio languages include English, Spanish and Portuguese, and [TurboScribe GPT](https://turboscribe.ai/blog/turboscribe-gpt-transcribe-and-chat) summarizes transcripts through ChatGPT.

A good fit if you mostly upload files, often from a computer, and don’t need an app.

## Verbi

Verbi is an AI voice recorder and note taker for iPhone and Android. It records in the app (long recordings fit within Pro’s hours, and the recording keeps going with the screen locked, on iPhone and on Android), imports files, and takes voice memos, WhatsApp and Telegram voice messages and other audio shared from any app, as well as video links. It transcribes 39 languages and can detect the language for you.

Summaries come from nine templates, such as Lesson Notes, General Meeting and Action Items, and contain only what was said: owners and due dates appear only when someone stated them. With Pro, every transcript gets a summary, and you can tell the speakers apart, chat with the transcript, translate it and export it as TXT or PDF; on the free plan, you get 3 summaries a month and can copy the text. Verbi needs no account, and recordings and transcripts are stored on your phone. To transcribe, the audio is sent to our speech-to-text providers (ElevenLabs and OpenAI), as the [privacy policy](https://theverbi.com/privacy-policy/) explains. The free plan includes 60 minutes of transcription a month.

A good fit if you record long lectures, meetings or interviews, work in more than one language or on both iPhone and Android, and want a summary shaped for the recording. Verbi has no web or desktop version.

## How do I choose a voice memo transcription app?

It depends on what you record and what you want from the text. Going by the table:

- Lectures you want as study notes: you need recording and a summary. Voice Memos and Notes summarize with Apple Intelligence on supported iPhones; Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe and Verbi write AI summaries, and Verbi’s Lesson Notes template keeps to what the lecturer said. See [how to record a lecture and get study notes](/lecture-recorder-transcription/).
- A recorder that transcribes and summarizes: Apple (with Apple Intelligence), Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe, TurboScribe (through ChatGPT) and Verbi all list AI summaries. Compare where you record (phone, browser or computer) and which languages you need.
- Free transcription on iPhone: Voice Memos and Notes are already on your iPhone 12 or later. Other apps’ plans change often, so we don’t list them here; Verbi’s free plan includes 60 minutes of transcription a month.
- Audio that shouldn’t leave the phone: Aiko transcribes on the device. For any other app, read its privacy page; Verbi sends the audio to its speech-to-text providers to transcribe it.
- Android as well: Otter, Notta, Transkriptor and Verbi have Android apps, and TurboScribe works in any browser.
- Working at a computer: Otter, Notta and Transkriptor have desktop apps, Transcribe has a Mac app and a web editor, and TurboScribe is web-based.
- A language that isn’t on Apple’s list: check each vendor’s own list. Verbi transcribes 39 languages, among them Turkish, Arabic, Hindi and Indonesian, and can detect the language for you.

## How do I transcribe a voice memo with Verbi?

1. Download Verbi from the App Store and open it. In Settings → Transcription Language, pick the language of the recording, or leave it on Auto-detect.
2. In Voice Memos, tap the recording and open the share sheet.
3. Choose Verbi. “Added to Verbi. Open the app to transcribe it.” means the recording was handed over. Share it in the default format: Apple’s [export page](https://support.apple.com/en-us/guide/iphone/iph831c37815/ios) says Options → Editable exports QuickTime Audio, a format Verbi doesn’t read.
4. Open Verbi. The recording is imported and transcribed; with Pro, you first choose the Number of Speakers. On iOS 26 or later, a long transcription keeps going if you leave the app, and Verbi sends a notification when it’s done; on older iOS versions, the upload continues in the background and the transcription is ready when you reopen Verbi.
5. Read, search or copy the text; with Pro, export it as TXT or PDF. A memo saved in Files can also be picked with Upload File. More in [how to transcribe an audio file or voice memo](/help/transcribe-audio-file/).

## Frequently asked questions

### Can iPhone transcribe voice memos without an app?

Yes, on iPhone 12 or later. Apple’s iPhone User Guide (iOS 27) says Voice Memos transcribes English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Chinese, and that the feature isn’t available in every country or region (checked October 26, 2026). Open the recording, tap the More button and choose Copy Transcript.

### What’s a free app to transcribe voice memos on iPhone?

If your recordings are in one of Apple’s transcription languages, Voice Memos itself is free and already installed. Other apps’ plans change often, so this page doesn’t list them; check each app’s own page. Verbi is free to download, and its free plan includes 60 minutes of transcription a month, recordings kept for 15 days and 3 AI summaries a month.

### Which app transcribes and summarizes voice recordings?

According to their own pages, Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe (DENIVIP) and Verbi write AI summaries; Apple’s Voice Memos and Notes summarize with Apple Intelligence on supported iPhones, and TurboScribe through ChatGPT. Verbi’s summaries come from nine templates and keep to what was said.

### Is Whisper an app?

No. Whisper is OpenAI’s [open-source speech recognition model](https://github.com/openai/whisper), not an iPhone app on its own. Apps build on it: Aiko, for example, runs Whisper on the device.

### Can I transcribe voice memos on Android?

Voice Memos is an Apple app, but Verbi, Otter, Notta and Transkriptor also have Android apps. On Pixel phones, Google’s Recorder app [transcribes English and several other languages](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267698?hl=en) as you record.

### Who made this comparison?

The team behind Verbi. For the other apps, the table uses only what their own pages, help centers and store listings say; anything they don’t state is marked “—”.

# Best lecture recorder apps for iPhone and Android (2026)

You may not need a new app to record a lecture: Apple’s own guide uses classroom lectures as an example for Voice Memos, which transcribes the recording on iPhone 12 or later, and Google’s Recorder does the same on Pixel phones. A dedicated lecture recorder helps when you want notes from the class rather than just a transcript, a lecture that runs past an hour handled in one piece, a recording you already have imported, or the same app on iPhone and Android. This page compares nine options using only what each vendor states on its own pages, checked on October 26, 2026.

## Can I record a lecture on iPhone without another app?

Yes. Apple’s guide to [making a recording in Voice Memos](https://support.apple.com/en-us/guide/iphone/iph4d2a39a3b/ios) mentions classroom lectures as an example and lets you record with the built-in microphone, a headset or an external microphone. On iPhone 12 or later, Voice Memos [transcribes the recording](https://support.apple.com/en-us/guide/iphone/iph00953a982/ios) in English (all variants), Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Chinese; Apple adds that the feature isn’t available in every country or region. You can copy the transcript and search across titles and transcripts, and with Apple Intelligence, Writing Tools can summarize it on supported iPhones.

The Notes app does the same inside a note: tap Record Audio, and Apple’s [Notes guide](https://support.apple.com/en-us/guide/iphone/iphbe11247b5/ios) says the speech is transcribed when the device language is one of those languages. If you mainly want to read or search what was said, these may be all you need. They don’t write lecture notes in a set structure, and they don’t run on Android.

## What should a lecture recorder app do?

- Record the whole class in one piece, even with the phone locked or in your bag.
- Turn the recording into text you can search: the exam date, a definition, the formula on the board.
- Make study notes from the transcript, without adding material the lecturer didn’t cover.
- Take a recording you already have, from another app, a file or a video.
- Handle the language of the class, especially if it isn’t English.

## Aiko

[Aiko](https://sindresorhus.com/aiko), from the independent developer Sindre Sorhus, turns recordings of meetings, lectures and voice memos into text with OpenAI’s Whisper model running on the device; the developer says the audio is never uploaded. It runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro, and its [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aiko/id1672085276) requires iOS 26 or later.

A good fit if you want the transcript and don’t need a summary, and prefer the audio to stay on your device.

## Verbi Lecture Recorder & Notes

Verbi Lecture Recorder & Notes is the App Store name of Verbi, an AI voice recorder and note taker for iPhone and Android. It records the whole class (also with the screen locked, on iPhone and on Android), imports audio and video files, recordings shared from other apps and YouTube links, and transcribes 39 languages with automatic language detection.

Its Lesson Notes template turns the transcript into notes that follow the class: definitions, rules, formulas, worked examples, and homework or exam dates only when the lecturer mentioned them. It doesn’t add textbook material that wasn’t taught, and marks a term as unclear rather than guessing. With Pro, you can ask a lecture questions (“What did she say about the exam?”), translate it and export it as TXT or PDF. Verbi needs no account; recordings and transcripts are stored on your phone, and the audio is sent to our speech-to-text providers to transcribe it, as the [privacy policy](https://theverbi.com/privacy-policy/) explains.

The free plan includes 60 minutes of transcription and 3 AI summaries a month, enough to try it in one class. For a full term, Pro includes 20 hours a month (or 5 a week on the weekly plan), and MAX twice that. Verbi has no web or desktop version. The steps are in the [lecture recorder guide](/lecture-recorder-transcription/).

## How do I choose a lecture recorder app?

It depends on what you want after class. Going by the table:

- A searchable transcript is enough: Voice Memos and Notes on iPhone 12 or later, or Recorder on a Pixel, are already on your phone.
- Study notes after every class: Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe and Verbi write AI summaries; Verbi’s Lesson Notes template is built for lectures and keeps to what was said. Apple and Google summarize on newer devices.
- Classes in a language Apple or Google doesn’t list: check each vendor’s own list. Verbi transcribes 39 languages, among them Arabic, Turkish and Indonesian, and detects the language for you.
- iPhone and Android: Otter, Notta, Transkriptor and Verbi have apps on both.
- Studying at a laptop: Otter, Notta and Transkriptor have desktop apps, and Transcribe has a Mac app and a web editor.
- Audio that shouldn’t leave the phone: Aiko transcribes on the device. For any other app, read its privacy page.
- Always: check that recording is allowed in your course, and ask the lecturer if you’re not sure.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is the best app to record lectures on iPhone?

It depends on what you need from the recording. For a searchable transcript, Voice Memos (iPhone 12 or later) is already installed. For study notes after each class, an app with AI summaries such as Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe or Verbi fits better; Verbi’s Lesson Notes template keeps to what the lecturer said. The table above compares them using each vendor’s own pages.

### Can I record a whole lecture with my phone locked?

In Verbi, yes: on iPhone and on Android (from version 1.2.0), the recording continues with the screen locked. For other apps, check their help pages.

### Can an app make lecture notes from an audio recording?

Yes. Import the recording into an app that summarizes transcripts. In Verbi, tap Upload File or share the recording to Verbi, and the Lesson Notes template turns the transcript into notes; the free plan includes 3 summaries a month.

### Is it legal to record a lecture?

Rules differ by school, course and place. Check your course policy, and ask the lecturer if you’re not sure.

### Can I record lectures on Android?

Yes. Verbi, Otter, Notta and Transkriptor have Android apps, and on Pixel phones Google’s Recorder [transcribes several languages](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267698?hl=en) as you record.

### Who made this comparison?

The team behind Verbi. For the other apps, the table uses only what their own pages, help centers and store listings say; anything they don’t state is marked “—”.

# Apps para transcrever áudio em português (2026)

Se você tem iPhone, talvez nem precise baixar nada: segundo o manual da Apple, o Gravador e o app Notas transcrevem áudio em português no iPhone 12 ou posterior. Outro app faz diferença quando você quer transcrever áudios do WhatsApp ou arquivos longos, receber um resumo pronto da aula ou da reunião, ou usar o mesmo app no Android. A tabela reúne o que cada fabricante informa nas próprias páginas, conferido em 26 de outubro de 2026.

## Quais apps transcrevem áudio em português?

Dados do Otter conferidos de novo em 19 de novembro de 2026.

## O iPhone transcreve áudio em português sem outro app?

Sim, a partir do iPhone 12. O [Manual de Uso do iPhone](https://support.apple.com/pt-br/guide/iphone/iph00953a982/ios) (iOS 27) diz que o Gravador transcreve a fala em inglês, espanhol, português, italiano, francês, alemão, japonês, coreano e chinês quando esse também é o idioma do aparelho, e que o recurso não está disponível em todos os países ou regiões. Dá para ver a transcrição enquanto grava, copiar tudo com Copiar Transcrição e buscar palavras nos títulos e nas transcrições. Com a Apple Intelligence, as Ferramentas de Escrita resumem a transcrição, o que no iOS 27 exige iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max ou iPhone 16 ou posterior.

O app Notas faz o mesmo dentro de uma nota: toque em Gravar Áudio, e, segundo o [manual do Notas](https://support.apple.com/pt-br/guide/iphone/iphbe11247b5/ios), a fala é transcrita nas mesmas condições, com resumo da Apple Intelligence nos modelos compatíveis. Se você só quer ler ou copiar o que foi dito, os apps da Apple podem bastar. Eles não recebem áudios do WhatsApp; para esses, veja a próxima seção.

## E os áudios do WhatsApp?

O próprio WhatsApp mostra a transcrição das mensagens de voz que você recebe, depois que você ativa o recurso. Segundo a Central de Ajuda, no [Android](https://faq.whatsapp.com/241617298315321/?cms_platform=android&locale=pt_BR) ela está disponível em inglês, português, espanhol e russo, no [iPhone](https://faq.whatsapp.com/241617298315321/?cms_platform=iphone&locale=pt_BR) os idiomas dependem do iOS (o português aparece a partir do iOS 16), e a transcrição é gerada no próprio aparelho.

Para guardar o texto de um áudio longo, buscar nele depois ou receber um resumo, compartilhe o áudio do WhatsApp com um app de transcrição. O Verbi recebe áudios do WhatsApp e do Telegram pelo menu de compartilhar, transcreve do começo ao fim e resume ([veja o passo a passo](/pt/ajuda/transcrever-audio-do-whatsapp/)); a ficha do Transcribe na App Store também cita mensagens de voz do WhatsApp.

## Gravador do Google (Pixel)

O Gravador do Google funciona em celulares Pixel 3 ou posterior e no Pixel Tablet ([ajuda do Google](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267668?hl=en)). Na [lista de idiomas](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267698?hl=en), o português (Brasil) aparece só no recurso “Transcribe again”, que transcreve de novo uma gravação e pode processar o áudio nos servidores do Google; ele não está na lista de transcrição em tempo real nem na dos resumos (Pixel 8 ou posterior).

Para quem faz sentido: quem tem um Pixel e quer transcrever uma gravação já feita, sem instalar outro app.

## Otter

O Otter tem app para iPhone e Android, versão web e [app para Mac e Windows](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/35973988280215-Otter-Desktop-App-Mac-Windows), grava e transcreve ao vivo, [importa arquivos](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047733574-Import-an-audio-or-video-file) e faz [resumos automáticos de reuniões](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/9156381229079-Meeting-Summary-Overview). A [lista de idiomas](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047247414-Supported-Languages) da central de ajuda inclui o português (Brasil) desde a atualização de 10 de novembro de 2026; segundo o [artigo sobre idiomas](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/26660468516631-Transcribe-conversations-in-different-languages-with-Otter), você escolhe o idioma falado antes de gravar ou importar um arquivo, e as configurações e os menus continuam em inglês. A [ficha da App Store no Brasil](https://apps.apple.com/br/app/otter-transcribe-voice-notes/id1276437113) mostra o app em inglês (conferido em 19 de novembro de 2026).

Para quem faz sentido: quem grava reuniões e quer as notas no celular, no navegador e no computador.

## Notta

O Notta funciona no iPhone e no Android, na web e no computador, com Windows e macOS ([ambientes compatíveis](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/18119588493467-Supported-environments)). No app, a tela inicial oferece [importar arquivos, gravar e transcrever reuniões ao vivo](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/17604467003803-Introduction-about-Notta-App); o português está na [lista de idiomas](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/4403155631131-What-languages-does-Notta-support), a [ficha da App Store](https://apps.apple.com/br/app/notta-transcribe-voice-to-text/id1480649572) mostra o app em português e descreve resumos com IA.

Para quem faz sentido: quem alterna entre celular e computador e grava em mais de um idioma.

## Transkriptor

O Transkriptor tem app para iOS e Android, versão web, extensão do Chrome e [app para Windows e Mac](https://transkriptor.com/desktop-app/). O [site](https://transkriptor.com/) lista o português, incluindo o português do Brasil, entre os idiomas de transcrição, e a [ficha da App Store](https://apps.apple.com/br/app/transkriptor-fala-para-texto/id1610386353) mostra o app em português e descreve gravador integrado, transcrição de arquivos, resumos e chat com a transcrição.

Para quem faz sentido: quem também quer gravar reuniões online pelo computador ou usar uma extensão no navegador.

## TurboScribe

O TurboScribe é um app web. A [central de ajuda](https://turboscribe.ai/help/does-turboscribe-have-a-mobile-app) diz que ele não tem app na App Store nem no Google Play e que o site funciona por completo no navegador do celular, com envio de arquivos, transcrição, tradução e exportação. O português está entre os idiomas de áudio, o [site em português](https://turboscribe.ai/pt/) tem interface em português, dá para [enviar um áudio ou gravar pelo microfone](https://turboscribe.ai/u/transcribe-voice-memos) e o [TurboScribe GPT](https://turboscribe.ai/blog/turboscribe-gpt-transcribe-and-chat) resume as transcrições pelo ChatGPT.

Para quem faz sentido: quem quer enviar arquivos, muitas vezes pelo computador, sem instalar app.

## Transcribe – Voz para texto (DENIVIP)

O Transcribe (DENIVIP Group OOO, App Store id1241342461) funciona no iPhone, no iPad, no Mac e num editor web em [transcribe.com](https://transcribe.com/). A [ficha da App Store](https://apps.apple.com/br/app/transcribe-speech-to-text/id1241342461) mostra o app em português e descreve gravador com transcrição ao vivo, envio de áudio e vídeo, identificação de falantes e resumos com IA; a [central de ajuda](https://transcribe.com/help-center) cita o português entre os idiomas. Há outros apps com nomes parecidos, então confira o desenvolvedor antes de baixar.

Para quem faz sentido: quem usa iPhone e Mac e quer editar a transcrição também no navegador.

## Verbi

O Verbi é um gravador de voz com IA para iPhone e Android. A partir da versão 1.4.0 no iPhone e 1.2.0 no Android, o app está em português, e os resumos e as respostas do chat saem em português quando o app está em português; a transcrição sai no idioma em que se falou, com detecção automática entre 39 idiomas.

Você grava no app (no Pro, gravações longas dentro das horas do plano; no iPhone, e no Android a partir da versão 1.2.0, a gravação continua com a tela bloqueada), importa um arquivo de áudio ou vídeo, compartilha um áudio do WhatsApp ou do Telegram ou cola um link de vídeo. Os resumos seguem nove modelos, como Notas de aula, Reunião geral e Lista de tarefas, e se atêm ao que foi dito: responsável e prazo só aparecem quando alguém os mencionou. No Pro, cada transcrição ganha um resumo, e você também identifica quem fala, conversa com a transcrição, traduz e exporta em TXT ou PDF; no plano grátis, você tem 3 resumos por mês e pode copiar o texto.

O Verbi não pede conta, e as gravações e transcrições ficam no seu celular. Para transcrever, o áudio é enviado aos nossos provedores de reconhecimento de fala (ElevenLabs e OpenAI), como explica a [política de privacidade](https://theverbi.com/privacy-policy/) (em inglês). O plano grátis inclui 60 minutos de transcrição por mês.

Para quem faz sentido: quem grava aulas, reuniões e entrevistas longas, recebe áudios compridos no WhatsApp ou usa iPhone e Android. O Verbi não tem versão web nem para computador.

## Como escolher um app para transcrever áudio em português?

Depende do que você grava e do que quer fazer com o texto. Pelo que mostra a tabela:

- Aulas da faculdade: você precisa gravar e de um resumo. O Gravador e o Notas resumem com a Apple Intelligence nos iPhones compatíveis; Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe e Verbi fazem resumos com IA, e o modelo Notas de aula do Verbi se atém ao que o professor disse. Veja [como gravar a aula e transcrever](/pt/gravar-aula-e-transcrever/).
- Reuniões: para quem trabalha no computador, Otter, Notta e Transkriptor têm app para Windows e Mac. O Verbi grava pelo microfone do celular e não entra na chamada como bot; veja [como fazer a ata de reunião](/pt/ata-de-reuniao-com-ia/).
- Sem gastar: o Gravador e o Notas já vêm no iPhone 12 ou posterior, e o WhatsApp transcreve as mensagens de voz recebidas. Os planos dos outros apps mudam com frequência, por isso não os listamos; o plano grátis do Verbi inclui 60 minutos de transcrição por mês.
- Áudios do WhatsApp longos que você quer guardar ou resumir: compartilhe com um app que importe o arquivo, como o Verbi.
- Android: Notta, Transkriptor, Otter e Verbi têm app para Android; no Pixel, o Gravador do Google transcreve português ao transcrever de novo uma gravação. O TurboScribe funciona em qualquer navegador.
- App em português: segundo as fichas da App Store no Brasil, Notta, Transkriptor e Transcribe estão em português; o Verbi também, a partir da versão 1.4.0 no iPhone e 1.2.0 no Android. O Otter mostra o app em inglês.
- Privacidade: veja onde cada app processa e guarda o áudio na página de privacidade dele. O Gravador do Google avisa que transcrever de novo pode usar os servidores do Google; o Verbi guarda as gravações no celular e envia o áudio aos provedores de transcrição.

## Como transcrever um áudio em português no Verbi?

1. Baixe o Verbi na App Store ou no Google Play. Em Ajustes → Idioma de transcrição, escolha Português ou deixe em Detecção automática.
2. Para gravar, toque em Gravar e transcrever. Se quiser ver o texto aparecendo enquanto alguém fala, escolha Transcrição ao vivo.
3. Para um áudio que você já tem, toque em Importar arquivo, ou compartilhe o áudio com o Verbi a partir do Gravador, do WhatsApp ou de outro app. No iPhone, espere a mensagem “Adicionado ao Verbi. Abra o app para transcrever.” e abra o Verbi.
4. Do Gravador do iPhone, compartilhe no formato padrão (.m4a). Segundo a Apple, a opção de exportar para editar camadas depois gera um arquivo QuickTime Audio, e esse formato o Verbi não lê.
5. Quando o texto ficar pronto, leia, busque ou copie. O plano grátis inclui 3 resumos por mês; no Pro, cada transcrição ganha um resumo, e você pode exportar em TXT ou PDF. Mais detalhes em [como transcrever áudio em texto](/pt/transcrever-audio-em-texto/).

## Perguntas frequentes

### Qual aplicativo transforma gravação de áudio em texto no iPhone?

O próprio iPhone faz isso: segundo o manual da Apple (iOS 27, conferido em 26 de outubro de 2026), o Gravador e o app Notas transcrevem português no iPhone 12 ou posterior. Entre os apps da App Store, Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe e Verbi transcrevem português e têm app para iPhone; o TurboScribe funciona no navegador.

### Existe app gratuito para transcrever áudio em texto?

O Gravador e o Notas já vêm no iPhone, e o WhatsApp transcreve as mensagens de voz recebidas. Os planos dos outros apps mudam com frequência, por isso não os listamos aqui; confira a página de cada um. O Verbi é grátis para baixar, e o plano grátis inclui 60 minutos de transcrição por mês, gravações guardadas por 15 dias e 3 resumos de IA por mês, sem criar conta.

### O Otter transcreve português?

Sim. O português (Brasil) está na lista de idiomas compatíveis da central de ajuda do Otter desde a atualização de 10 de novembro de 2026 (conferido em 19 de novembro de 2026). No Otter, você escolhe o idioma falado antes de gravar ou importar, e o app continua em inglês.

### O Gravador do Google transcreve português?

Segundo a ajuda do Google, o português (Brasil) aparece só na lista do recurso “Transcribe again”, que transcreve de novo uma gravação e pode processar o áudio nos servidores do Google. Ele não está na lista de transcrição em tempo real nem na dos resumos.

### O resumo sai em português?

No Verbi, sim, com o app em português (a partir da versão 1.4.0 no iPhone e 1.2.0 no Android): os resumos e as respostas do chat saem no idioma do app, e a transcrição fica no idioma em que se falou.

### Quem fez este comparativo?

A equipe do Verbi. Para os outros apps, usamos só o que está nas páginas oficiais, nas centrais de ajuda e nas fichas das lojas; o que a fonte não informa aparece como “—”.

# App per trascrivere audio in italiano (2026)

Se hai un iPhone, forse non ti serve scaricare niente: secondo il manuale di Apple, Memo Vocali e l’app Note trascrivono l’italiano su iPhone 12 o successivi. Un’altra app fa la differenza quando vuoi trascrivere i vocali di WhatsApp o file lunghi, avere un riassunto pronto della lezione o della riunione, o usare la stessa app anche su Android. La tabella raccoglie quello che ogni produttore dichiara nelle proprie pagine, verificato il 4 novembre 2026.

## Quali app trascrivono audio in italiano?

| App | Piattaforme | Trascrive l’italiano | App in italiano | Registra dal telefono | Importa un file | Riassunto con AI |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Memo Vocali (Apple) | iPhone, iPad, Mac | Sì, su iPhone 12 o successivi¹ | Sì | Sì, con trascrizione dal vivo | — | In parte: con gli Strumenti di scrittura di Apple Intelligence² |
| Note di iPhone («Registra audio» in una nota) | iPhone | Sì, su iPhone 12 o successivi, se l’italiano è anche la lingua del dispositivo | Sì | Sì, con trascrizione dal vivo | — | Sì, con Apple Intelligence² |
| Registratore di Google (Recorder, telefoni Pixel) | Pixel 3 o successivi, Pixel Tablet | Sì, dal vivo su Pixel 6 o successivi | — | Sì | — | Sì, su Pixel 8 o successivi, anche in italiano |
| Otter | iOS, Android, web, computer (Mac, Windows) | Sì, è nell’elenco delle lingue supportate³ | No, in inglese⁴ | Sì, dal vivo | Sì | Sì |
| Notta | iOS, Android, web, computer (Windows, macOS) | Sì | Sì⁴ | Sì | Sì | Sì |
| Transkriptor | iOS, Android, web, estensione di Chrome, computer (Windows, Mac) | Sì | Sì⁴ | Sì | Sì | Sì |
| TurboScribe | Web, anche dal browser del telefono | Sì | Sì, sul sito | In parte: nel browser, con il microfono | Sì | In parte: con TurboScribe GPT (ChatGPT) |
| Transcribe – Da voce a testo (DENIVIP · App Store id1241342461) | iPhone, iPad, Mac, web | Sì | Sì⁴ | Sì, con trascrizione dal vivo | Sì | Sì |
| Verbi | iPhone, Android | Sì, con rilevamento automatico della lingua | Sì, dalla versione 1.4.0 (iPhone) e 1.2.0 (Android) | Sì, con trascrizione dal vivo | Sì; anche vocali di WhatsApp e Telegram e link di YouTube | Sì: nove modelli, in italiano con l’app in italiano |

— La fonte non lo indica.

¹ Il manuale di Apple precisa che la trascrizione non è disponibile in tutti i paesi o in tutte le zone. ² Su iOS 27 Apple Intelligence richiede iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max o iPhone 16 e successivi. ³ Otter ha aggiunto l’italiano all’elenco il 10 novembre 2026; la lingua parlata si sceglie prima di registrare o importare. Dati di Otter verificati di nuovo il 19 novembre 2026. ⁴ Lingue dell’app secondo la scheda dell’App Store italiano; il centro assistenza di Otter dice che impostazioni e menu restano in inglese.

## iPhone trascrive l’audio in italiano senza altre app?

Sì, da iPhone 12 in poi. Il [Manuale utente di iPhone](https://support.apple.com/it-it/guide/iphone/iph00953a982/ios) (iOS 27) dice che Memo Vocali, nella cartella Utility, trascrive il parlato in italiano, inglese, spagnolo, portoghese, francese, tedesco, giapponese, coreano e cinese, e che la funzione non è disponibile in tutti i paesi o in tutte le zone. Puoi leggere la trascrizione mentre registri, copiarla con «Copia trascrizione» e cercare parole nei titoli e nelle trascrizioni. Con Apple Intelligence, gli Strumenti di scrittura riassumono la trascrizione, il che su iOS 27 richiede iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max o iPhone 16 e successivi.

L’app Note fa lo stesso dentro una nota: tocca «Registra audio» e, secondo il [manuale di Note](https://support.apple.com/it-it/guide/iphone/iphbe11247b5/ios), il parlato viene trascritto quando anche la lingua del dispositivo è tra quelle supportate; poi puoi usare «Copia trascrizione» o «Aggiungi trascrizione alla nota». Se ti basta leggere o copiare quello che è stato detto, le app di Apple possono bastare. Non ricevono però i vocali di WhatsApp: per quelli, vedi la sezione successiva.

## E i vocali di WhatsApp?

WhatsApp mostra la trascrizione dei messaggi vocali che ricevi, dopo che hai attivato la funzione, e la genera sul dispositivo. Secondo il Centro assistenza, su [iPhone](https://faq.whatsapp.com/241617298315321/?cms_platform=iphone&locale=it_IT) l’italiano è tra le lingue disponibili da iOS 16; su [Android](https://faq.whatsapp.com/241617298315321/?cms_platform=android&locale=it_IT) al momento le lingue supportate sono solo inglese, portoghese, spagnolo e russo.

Per avere il testo di un vocale in italiano su Android, o per conservare, cercare e riassumere un vocale lungo, condividilo con un’app di trascrizione. Verbi riceve i vocali di WhatsApp e Telegram dal menu di condivisione, li trascrive dall’inizio alla fine e li riassume ([ecco i passaggi](/it/assistenza/trascrivere-vocali-whatsapp/)).

## Registratore di Google (Pixel)

Il Registratore di Google funziona su Pixel 3 o successivi e su Pixel Tablet ([assistenza Google](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267668?hl=en)). Secondo l’[elenco delle lingue](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267698?hl=en), l’italiano c’è nella trascrizione dal vivo (Pixel 6 o successivi), nella funzione «Transcribe again» e nei riassunti (Pixel 8 o successivi).

Per chi è adatto: chi ha un Pixel recente e registra in italiano.

## Otter

Otter ha app per iPhone e Android, una versione web e un’[app per Mac e Windows](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/35973988280215-Otter-Desktop-App-Mac-Windows), registra e trascrive dal vivo, [importa file](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047733574-Import-an-audio-or-video-file) e scrive [riassunti automatici delle riunioni](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/9156381229079-Meeting-Summary-Overview). L’[elenco delle lingue](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047247414-Supported-Languages) del centro assistenza include l’italiano dall’aggiornamento del 10 novembre 2026; secondo l’[articolo sulle lingue](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/26660468516631-Transcribe-conversations-in-different-languages-with-Otter), scegli la lingua parlata prima di registrare o importare un file, e impostazioni e menu restano in inglese. La [scheda dell’App Store italiano](https://apps.apple.com/it/app/otter-transcribe-voice-notes/id1276437113) mostra l’app in inglese (verificato il 19 novembre 2026).

Per chi è adatto: chi registra riunioni e vuole gli appunti su telefono, browser e computer.

## Notta

Notta funziona su iPhone e Android, sul web e su computer Windows e macOS ([ambienti supportati](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/18119588493467-Supported-environments)). Nell’app, la schermata iniziale offre [importare file, registrare e trascrivere riunioni dal vivo](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/17604467003803-Introduction-about-Notta-App); l’italiano è nell’[elenco delle lingue](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/4403155631131-What-languages-does-Notta-support), e la [scheda dell’App Store](https://apps.apple.com/it/app/notta-transcribe-voice-to-text/id1480649572) mostra l’app in italiano e descrive riassunti con AI.

Per chi è adatto: chi passa dal telefono al computer e registra in più lingue.

## Transkriptor

Transkriptor ha app per iOS e Android, una versione web, un’estensione di Chrome e un’[app per Windows e Mac](https://transkriptor.com/desktop-app/). Il [sito](https://transkriptor.com/) elenca l’italiano tra le lingue di trascrizione, e la [scheda dell’App Store](https://apps.apple.com/it/app/transkriptor-voce-in-testo/id1610386353) («Transkriptor - Voce in Testo») mostra l’app in italiano e descrive registratore integrato, trascrizione di file, riassunti e chat con la trascrizione.

Per chi è adatto: chi vuole registrare anche le riunioni online dal computer o usare un’estensione nel browser.

## TurboScribe

TurboScribe è un’app web. Il [centro assistenza](https://turboscribe.ai/help/does-turboscribe-have-a-mobile-app) dice che non ha un’app sull’App Store né su Google Play e che il sito funziona per intero nel browser del telefono, con caricamento dei file, trascrizione, traduzione ed esportazione. Il [sito in italiano](https://turboscribe.ai/it/) offre l’italiano come lingua dell’audio, puoi [caricare un audio o registrare con il microfono](https://turboscribe.ai/u/transcribe-voice-memos) e [TurboScribe GPT](https://turboscribe.ai/blog/turboscribe-gpt-transcribe-and-chat) riassume le trascrizioni tramite ChatGPT.

Per chi è adatto: chi carica file, spesso dal computer, senza installare app.

## Transcribe – Da voce a testo (DENIVIP)

Transcribe (DENIVIP Group OOO, App Store id1241342461) funziona su iPhone, iPad, Mac e in un editor web su [transcribe.com](https://transcribe.com/). La [scheda dell’App Store](https://apps.apple.com/it/app/transcribe-da-voce-a-testo/id1241342461) mostra l’app in italiano e descrive registratore con trascrizione dal vivo, caricamento di audio e video, riconoscimento di chi parla e riassunti con AI; il [centro assistenza](https://transcribe.com/help-center) cita l’italiano tra le lingue. Ci sono altre app con nomi simili: controlla lo sviluppatore prima di scaricarla.

Per chi è adatto: chi usa iPhone e Mac e vuole modificare la trascrizione anche nel browser.

## Verbi

Verbi è un registratore vocale con AI per iPhone e Android. Dalla versione 1.4.0 su iPhone e 1.2.0 su Android l’app è in italiano, e riassunti e risposte della chat arrivano in italiano quando l’app è in italiano; la trascrizione resta nella lingua in cui si parla, con rilevamento automatico tra 39 lingue.

Registri nell’app (con Pro, registrazioni lunghe entro le ore del piano; su iPhone, e su Android dalla versione 1.2.0, la registrazione continua anche con lo schermo bloccato), importi un file audio o video, condividi un vocale di WhatsApp o Telegram o incolli un link di YouTube. I riassunti seguono nove modelli, come appunti di lezione, riunione generale e azioni da fare, e restano fedeli a quello che è stato detto: responsabili e scadenze compaiono solo se qualcuno li ha nominati. Con Pro ogni trascrizione ha il suo riassunto, e puoi anche riconoscere chi parla, chattare con la trascrizione, tradurla ed esportarla in TXT o PDF; con il piano gratuito hai 3 riassunti al mese e puoi copiare il testo.

Verbi non chiede un account, e registrazioni e trascrizioni restano sul tuo telefono. Per la trascrizione l’audio viene inviato ai nostri fornitori di riconoscimento vocale (ElevenLabs e OpenAI), come spiega l’[informativa sulla privacy](https://theverbi.com/privacy-policy/) (in inglese). Il piano gratuito include 60 minuti di trascrizione al mese.

Per chi è adatto: chi registra lezioni, riunioni e interviste lunghe, riceve vocali lunghi su WhatsApp o usa sia iPhone sia Android. Verbi non ha una versione web né per computer.

## Come scegliere un’app per trascrivere audio in italiano?

Dipende da cosa registri e da cosa vuoi fare con il testo. In base alla tabella:

- Lezioni universitarie: ti servono la registrazione e un riassunto. Memo Vocali e Note riassumono con Apple Intelligence sugli iPhone compatibili; Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe e Verbi scrivono riassunti con AI, e il modello per gli appunti di lezione di Verbi resta fedele a quello che ha detto il docente. Vedi [come registrare le lezioni e sbobinarle](/it/registrare-lezioni-universitarie/).
- Riunioni: se lavori al computer, Otter, Notta e Transkriptor hanno app per Windows e Mac. Verbi registra con il microfono del telefono e non entra nella chiamata come bot; vedi [come fare il verbale di una riunione](/it/verbale-riunione-ai/).
- Senza spendere: Memo Vocali e Note sono già su iPhone 12 o successivi, e su iPhone WhatsApp trascrive i vocali ricevuti. I piani delle altre app cambiano spesso, quindi non li elenchiamo; il piano gratuito di Verbi include 60 minuti di trascrizione al mese.
- Vocali di WhatsApp su Android: la trascrizione di WhatsApp non supporta l’italiano su Android; condividi il vocale con un’app che importa il file, come Verbi.
- Android: Notta, Transkriptor, Otter e Verbi hanno un’app per Android; sui Pixel il Registratore di Google trascrive l’italiano dal vivo. TurboScribe funziona in qualsiasi browser.
- App in italiano: secondo le schede dell’App Store italiano, Notta, Transkriptor e Transcribe sono in italiano; anche Verbi, dalla versione 1.4.0 su iPhone e 1.2.0 su Android. Otter mostra l’app in inglese.
- Privacy: controlla nella pagina sulla privacy di ogni app dove viene elaborato e conservato l’audio. Verbi conserva le registrazioni sul telefono e invia l’audio ai fornitori di trascrizione.

## Come si trascrive un audio in italiano con Verbi?

1. Scarica Verbi dall’App Store o da Google Play. In «Impostazioni» → «Lingua di trascrizione» scegli «Italiano», oppure lascia «Rilevamento automatico».
2. Per registrare tocca «Record & Transcribe» (registra e trascrivi). Se vuoi vedere il testo comparire mentre qualcuno parla, scegli «Live Transcription» (trascrizione dal vivo).
3. Per un audio che hai già, tocca «Upload File» (carica file), oppure condividi l’audio con Verbi da Memo Vocali, da WhatsApp o da un’altra app. Su iPhone, aspetta il messaggio «Added to Verbi. Open the app to transcribe it.» (aggiunto a Verbi, apri l’app per trascriverlo) e apri Verbi.
4. Da Memo Vocali condividi nel formato predefinito (.m4a). Secondo la [pagina di Apple sull’esportazione](https://support.apple.com/it-it/guide/iphone/iph831c37815/ios), l’opzione «Modificabile» esporta in formato QuickTime audio, che Verbi non legge.
5. Quando il testo è pronto, leggilo, cercaci dentro o copialo. Il piano gratuito include 3 riassunti al mese; con Pro ogni trascrizione ha un riassunto e puoi esportare in TXT o PDF. Altri dettagli in [come trascrivere audio in testo](/it/trascrivere-audio-in-testo/). Le voci dell’app sono citate in inglese, con il significato tra parentesi; con l’app in italiano le vedi in italiano ([lingue di Verbi](/it/assistenza/lingue/)).

## Domande frequenti

### Quale app trasforma una registrazione audio in testo su iPhone?

Lo fa già iPhone: secondo il manuale di Apple (iOS 27, verificato il 4 novembre 2026), Memo Vocali e l’app Note trascrivono l’italiano su iPhone 12 o successivi. Tra le app dell’App Store, Otter, Notta, Transkriptor, Transcribe e Verbi trascrivono l’italiano e hanno un’app per iPhone; TurboScribe funziona nel browser.

### Esiste un’app gratis per trascrivere audio in testo?

Memo Vocali e Note sono già su iPhone, e su iPhone WhatsApp trascrive i vocali ricevuti. I piani delle altre app cambiano spesso, quindi non li elenchiamo qui; controlla la pagina di ciascuna. Verbi si scarica gratis, e il piano gratuito include 60 minuti di trascrizione al mese, registrazioni conservate per 15 giorni e 3 riassunti AI al mese, senza creare un account.

### Otter trascrive l’italiano?

Sì. L’italiano è nell’elenco delle lingue supportate del centro assistenza di Otter dall’aggiornamento del 10 novembre 2026 (verificato il 19 novembre 2026). In Otter scegli la lingua parlata prima di registrare o importare, e l’app resta in inglese.

### WhatsApp trascrive i vocali in italiano?

Su iPhone sì: secondo il Centro assistenza di WhatsApp, l’italiano è tra le lingue disponibili da iOS 16. Su Android, al momento la trascrizione supporta solo inglese, portoghese, spagnolo e russo (verificato il 4 novembre 2026).

### Il riassunto arriva in italiano?

In Verbi sì, con l’app in italiano (dalla versione 1.4.0 su iPhone e 1.2.0 su Android): riassunti e risposte della chat arrivano nella lingua dell’app, e la trascrizione resta nella lingua in cui si parla.

### Chi ha fatto questo confronto?

Il team di Verbi. Per le altre app usiamo solo quello che dicono le loro pagine ufficiali, i centri assistenza e le schede degli store; quello che la fonte non indica è segnato con «—».

# تطبيقات تحويل الصوت العربي إلى نص (2026)

إن كنت تسجّل بالعربية فلن تجد التفريغ جاهزًا في هاتفك غالبًا: العربية ليست ضمن لغات النسخ النصي في المذكرات الصوتية والملاحظات على iPhone بحسب دليل Apple، ولا في قوائم «المسجّلة الذكية» على هواتف Pixel، ولا في قائمة لغات Otter. أما Notta وTranskriptor وTurboScribe وVerbi فتذكر العربية بين لغات التفريغ، ويفرّغ WhatsApp على iPhone الرسائل الصوتية العربية التي تصلك. يجمع الجدول ما تذكره كل جهة في صفحاتها الرسمية، كما راجعناه في 19 نوفمبر 2026.

## أي التطبيقات تفرّغ الصوت العربي إلى نص؟

| التطبيق | الأجهزة | يفرّغ العربية | واجهة بالعربية | التسجيل من الهاتف | استيراد ملف | ملخص بالذكاء الاصطناعي |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| المذكرات الصوتية (Apple) | iPhone | ليست في قائمة لغات النسخ النصي في دليل Apple¹ | نعم | نعم، مع نص مباشر باللغات المدعومة | — | عبر أدوات الكتابة في ذكاء Apple، للنصوص باللغات المدعومة² |
| الملاحظات في iPhone («تسجيل الصوت» داخل ملاحظة) | iPhone | ليست في قائمة لغات النسخ النصي في دليل Apple¹ | نعم | نعم، مع نص مباشر باللغات المدعومة | — | عبر ذكاء Apple، للنصوص باللغات المدعومة² |
| المسجّلة الذكية من Google (Recorder، هواتف Pixel) | Pixel 3 وأحدث، وPixel Tablet | ليست في قوائم لغات التفريغ في مساعدة Google³ | — | نعم | — | على Pixel 8 وأحدث؛ والعربية ليست في قائمة لغات الملخص³ |
| Otter | iOS وAndroid والويب والكمبيوتر (Mac وWindows) | ليست في قائمة اللغات المدعومة³ | لا، بالإنجليزية⁴ | نعم، مع تفريغ مباشر | نعم | نعم |
| Notta | iOS وAndroid والويب والكمبيوتر (Windows وmacOS) | نعم: العربية (مصر) والعربية (الإمارات) | نعم⁴ | نعم، مع تفريغ مباشر | نعم | نعم |
| Transkriptor | iOS وAndroid والويب وإضافة Chrome والكمبيوتر (Windows وMac) | نعم | نعم⁴، والموقع بالعربية أيضًا | نعم | نعم | نعم |
| TurboScribe | الويب، ومنه متصفح الهاتف | نعم | الموقع بالعربية | — | نعم | جزئيًا: عبر TurboScribe GPT (ChatGPT) |
| Verbi | iPhone وAndroid | نعم، مع اكتشاف تلقائي للغة | نعم، من الإصدار 1.5.0 (iPhone) و1.3.0 (Android) | نعم، مع تفريغ مباشر | نعم؛ ورسائل WhatsApp وTelegram الصوتية وروابط YouTube أيضًا | نعم: تسعة قوالب، بالعربية حين تكون الواجهة بالعربية |

— لا يذكره المصدر.

¹ دليل مستخدم iPhone (iOS 27) كما راجعناه في 19 نوفمبر 2026، ويذكر أيضًا أن الميزة لا تتوفر في بعض الدول أو المناطق. ² على iOS 27 يتطلب ذكاء Apple جهاز iPhone 15 Pro أو iPhone 15 Pro Max أو iPhone 16 وأحدث، والعربية ليست بين لغات Siri والجهاز التي يذكرها دليل Apple لذكاء Apple (19 نوفمبر 2026). ³ راجعناها في 19 نوفمبر 2026، وقد تتغيّر القائمة. ⁴ لغات التطبيق بحسب صفحته في App Store السعودي.

## هل يفرّغ iPhone الصوت العربي دون تطبيق آخر؟

ليس بحسب دليل Apple. يذكر [دليل مستخدم iPhone](https://support.apple.com/ar-sa/guide/iphone/iph00953a982/ios) (iOS 27) أن النسخ النصي للصوت في المذكرات الصوتية يتوفر على iPhone 12 أو أحدث بالإنجليزية والإسبانية والبرتغالية والإيطالية والفرنسية والألمانية واليابانية والكورية والصينية المبسطة والتقليدية، ولا تَرِد العربية في هذه القائمة (19 نوفمبر 2026). ويمكنك بالطبع التسجيل بالعربية في المذكرات الصوتية، لكن الدليل لا يذكر نصًّا عربيًا للتسجيل.

والأمر نفسه في تطبيق الملاحظات: بحسب [دليل الملاحظات](https://support.apple.com/ar-sa/guide/iphone/iphbe11247b5/ios) يتوفر النسخ النصي عند «تسجيل الصوت» في ملاحظة حين تكون لغة الجهاز إحدى اللغات نفسها، والعربية ليست بينها. وتلخيص ذكاء Apple يعمل على النصوص المنسوخة، والعربية ليست كذلك بين لغات Siri والجهاز التي يذكرها الدليل لذكاء Apple. قد تتغيّر هذه القوائم مع تحديثات iOS، فراجع صفحة الدليل لإصدار iOS في هاتفك. ولتفريغ تسجيل عربي من المذكرات الصوتية شاركه مع تطبيق يفرّغ العربية؛ والخطوات في آخر الصفحة.

## وماذا عن رسائل WhatsApp الصوتية؟

يعرض WhatsApp تفريغًا نصيًا للرسائل الصوتية التي تصلك بعد تفعيل الميزة، ويُنشئه على جهازك. وبحسب مركز المساعدة، فالعربية على [iPhone](https://faq.whatsapp.com/241617298315321/?cms_platform=iphone&locale=ar_AR) ضمن اللغات المدعومة من iOS 16، ويجب تفعيل Siri. أما على [Android](https://faq.whatsapp.com/241617298315321/?cms_platform=android&locale=ar_AR) فاللغات المدعومة حاليًا هي الإنجليزية والبرتغالية والإسبانية والروسية فقط (19 نوفمبر 2026).

فإن أردت نص رسالة صوتية عربية على Android، أو أردت حفظ رسالة طويلة والبحث فيها وتلخيصها، فشاركها مع تطبيق تفريغ. يستقبل Verbi رسائل WhatsApp وTelegram الصوتية من قائمة المشاركة، ويفرّغها من أولها إلى آخرها ويلخّصها ([الخطوات هنا](/ar/help/transcribe-whatsapp-voice-messages/)).

## المسجّلة الذكية من Google (هواتف Pixel)

يعمل تطبيق «المسجّلة الذكية» على هواتف Pixel 3 وأحدث وعلى Pixel Tablet ([مساعدة Google](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267668?hl=ar)). وفي [صفحة اللغات](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267698?hl=ar) لا تَرِد العربية في قائمة التفريغ في الوقت الفعلي، ولا في قائمة إعادة التفريغ، ولا في لغات الملخص على Pixel 8 وأحدث (19 نوفمبر 2026).

لمن يناسب: من يملك هاتف Pixel ويسجّل بإحدى اللغات المدرجة في تلك القوائم.

## Otter

لـ Otter تطبيقات لـ iPhone وAndroid ونسخة ويب و[تطبيق لـ Mac وWindows](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/35973988280215-Otter-Desktop-App-Mac-Windows)، وتذكر [صفحته في App Store](https://apps.apple.com/sa/app/otter-transcribe-voice-notes/id1276437113) التسجيل والتفريغ المباشر واستيراد ملفات الصوت والفيديو وملخصات الاجتماعات. ولا تَرِد العربية في [قائمة اللغات المدعومة](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047247414-Supported-Languages) في مركز مساعدته (19 نوفمبر 2026)، وتعرض صفحته في App Store السعودي التطبيق بالإنجليزية.

لمن يناسب: من يسجّل اجتماعات بإحدى لغات القائمة، كالإنجليزية، ويريد الملاحظات على الهاتف والمتصفح والكمبيوتر.

## Notta

يعمل Notta على iPhone وAndroid والويب وعلى كمبيوتر Windows وmacOS ([البيئات المدعومة](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/18119588493467-Supported-environments)). وتضم [قائمة لغاته](https://support.notta.ai/hc/en-us/articles/4403155631131-What-languages-does-Notta-support) للتفريغ أحادي اللغة العربية (مصر) والعربية (الإمارات). وتعرض [صفحته في App Store](https://apps.apple.com/sa/app/notta-transcribe-voice-to-text/id1480649572) العربية بين لغات التطبيق، وتذكر التفريغ المباشر واستيراد ملفات الصوت والفيديو والملخصات بالذكاء الاصطناعي.

لمن يناسب: من يتنقّل بين الهاتف والكمبيوتر ويسجّل بأكثر من لغة.

## Transkriptor

لـ Transkriptor تطبيقات لـ iOS وAndroid ونسخة ويب وإضافة لـ Chrome و[تطبيق لـ Windows وMac](https://transkriptor.com/desktop-app/). ويذكر [موقعه بالعربية](https://transkriptor.com/ar/) العربية بين لغات التفريغ، وتعرض [صفحته في App Store](https://apps.apple.com/sa/app/transkriptor-speech-to-text/id1610386353) العربية بين لغات التطبيق، وتذكر مسجّلًا مدمجًا وتفريغ الملفات والملخصات والدردشة مع النص.

لمن يناسب: من يريد تسجيل الاجتماعات عبر الإنترنت من الكمبيوتر أيضًا، أو استخدام إضافة في المتصفح.

## TurboScribe

TurboScribe تطبيق ويب. يقول [مركز مساعدته](https://turboscribe.ai/help/does-turboscribe-have-a-mobile-app) إنه لا يوجد تطبيق له في App Store ولا Google Play، وإن الموقع يعمل كاملًا من متصفح الهاتف: رفع الملفات والتفريغ والترجمة والتصدير. ويذكر [موقعه بالعربية](https://turboscribe.ai/ar/) العربية بين اللغات التي يعطي فيها أفضل النتائج، ويلخّص [TurboScribe GPT](https://turboscribe.ai/blog/turboscribe-gpt-transcribe-and-chat) النصوص عبر ChatGPT.

لمن يناسب: من يرفع ملفات، غالبًا من الكمبيوتر، دون تثبيت تطبيق.

## Verbi

Verbi مسجّل صوتي ومدوّن ملاحظات بالذكاء الاصطناعي لـ iPhone وAndroid. التطبيق بالعربية منذ الإصدار 1.5.0 على iPhone و1.3.0 على Android، وتصلك الملخصات وإجابات الدردشة بالعربية حين تكون الواجهة بالعربية؛ أما النص فيبقى بلغة الكلام، مع اكتشاف تلقائي بين 39 لغة منها العربية.

تسجّل داخل التطبيق (مع Pro تسجيلات طويلة ضمن ساعات الباقة؛ وعلى iPhone وAndroid يستمر التسجيل والشاشة مقفلة)، أو تستورد ملفًا صوتيًا أو مرئيًا، أو تشارك رسالة صوتية من WhatsApp أو Telegram، أو تلصق رابط YouTube. وتتبع الملخصات تسعة قوالب، منها «ملاحظات الدرس» و«اجتماع عام» و«بنود العمل»، وتلتزم بما قيل: لا تظهر المسؤوليات والمواعيد إلا إذا ذكرها أحد. ومع Pro يحصل كل نص على ملخص، ويمكنك التعرّف على المتحدثين والدردشة مع النص وترجمته وتصديره بصيغة TXT أو PDF؛ وفي الباقة المجانية 3 ملخصات شهريًا ونسخ النص.

لا يطلب Verbi إنشاء حساب، وتبقى التسجيلات والنصوص على هاتفك. وللتفريغ يُرسَل الصوت إلى مزوّدي التعرّف على الكلام لدينا (ElevenLabs وOpenAI)، كما توضّح [سياسة الخصوصية](https://theverbi.com/privacy-policy/) (بالإنجليزية). وتتضمن الباقة المجانية 60 دقيقة من التفريغ شهريًا.

لمن يناسب: من يسجّل محاضرات واجتماعات ومقابلات طويلة بالعربية، أو تصله رسائل صوتية طويلة على WhatsApp، أو يستخدم iPhone وAndroid معًا. ليس لـ Verbi نسخة ويب ولا تطبيق للكمبيوتر.

## كيف أختار تطبيقًا لتفريغ الصوت العربي؟

يعتمد ذلك على ما تسجّله وما تريد فعله بالنص. وبحسب الجدول:

- المحاضرات الجامعية: تحتاج إلى التسجيل وإلى ملخص. يكتب Notta وTranskriptor وVerbi ملخصات بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ويلتزم قالب «ملاحظات الدرس» في Verbi بما قاله المحاضر. راجع [كيف تسجّل المحاضرات وتفرّغها](/ar/lecture-recorder-transcription/).
- الاجتماعات: إن كنت تعمل على الكمبيوتر فلـ Notta وTranskriptor تطبيقات لـ Windows وMac، ويفرّغان العربية. يسجّل Verbi بميكروفون الهاتف ولا ينضم إلى المكالمة كروبوت؛ راجع [ملاحظات الاجتماعات بالذكاء الاصطناعي](/ar/ai-meeting-notes/).
- المقابلات: تحتاج إلى نص كامل يمكن البحث فيه، ويفيد التعرّف على المتحدثين. راجع [تفريغ المقابلات](/ar/interview-transcription/).
- دون إنفاق: على iPhone يفرّغ WhatsApp الرسائل الصوتية العربية التي تصلك. خطط التطبيقات الأخرى تتغيّر كثيرًا فلا نذكرها هنا؛ وتتضمن الباقة المجانية في Verbi 60 دقيقة من التفريغ شهريًا.
- رسائل WhatsApp الصوتية على Android: العربية ليست في قائمة لغات التفريغ في WhatsApp على Android (19 نوفمبر 2026)؛ شارك الرسالة مع تطبيق يستورد الملفات، مثل Verbi.
- تسجيلات المذكرات الصوتية في iPhone: لا يذكر دليل Apple نصًّا عربيًا لها؛ صدّرها أو شاركها مع تطبيق يفرّغ العربية.
- Android: لـ Notta وTranskriptor وVerbi تطبيقات لـ Android وتفرّغ العربية، ويعمل TurboScribe في أي متصفح.
- واجهة بالعربية: بحسب صفحاتها في App Store السعودي، Notta وTranskriptor بالعربية، وكذلك Verbi منذ الإصدار 1.5.0 على iPhone و1.3.0 على Android. ويعرض Otter التطبيق بالإنجليزية.
- الخصوصية: راجع صفحة الخصوصية لكل تطبيق لتعرف أين يُعالَج الصوت ويُحفظ. يحفظ Verbi التسجيلات على الهاتف ويرسل الصوت إلى مزوّدي التفريغ.

## كيف أفرّغ تسجيلًا عربيًا بـ Verbi؟

1. نزّل Verbi من App Store أو Google Play. من «الإعدادات» ← «لغة التفريغ» اختر «العربية»، أو اترك «اكتشاف تلقائي».
2. للتسجيل اضغط «تسجيل وتفريغ». وإن أردت رؤية النص وهو يظهر أثناء الحديث فاختر «التفريغ المباشر».
3. لصوت موجود لديك اضغط «رفع ملف»، أو شارك الصوت إلى Verbi من المذكرات الصوتية أو WhatsApp أو تطبيق آخر. على iPhone انتظر ظهور «أُضيف إلى Verbi. افتح التطبيق لتفريغه.» ثم افتح Verbi.
4. من المذكرات الصوتية شارك بالتنسيق الافتراضي (.m4a). فبحسب [صفحة Apple عن التصدير](https://support.apple.com/ar-sa/guide/iphone/iph831c37815/ios)، يصدّر خيار «قابل للتعديل» بتنسيق صوت QuickTime، وهو تنسيق لا يقرؤه Verbi.
5. عندما يصبح النص جاهزًا اقرأه أو ابحث فيه أو انسخه. تتضمن الباقة المجانية 3 ملخصات شهريًا؛ ومع Pro يحصل كل نص على ملخص ويمكنك التصدير بصيغة TXT أو PDF. ولتصلك الملخصات بالعربية اجعل «الإعدادات» ← «اللغة» على «العربية» ([لغات Verbi](/ar/help/languages/)). وتفاصيل أكثر في [تحويل الصوت إلى نص](/ar/voice-to-text/).

## الأسئلة الشائعة

### ما التطبيق الذي يحوّل تسجيلًا صوتيًا عربيًا إلى نص على iPhone؟

لا يذكر دليل Apple العربية بين لغات النسخ النصي في المذكرات الصوتية والملاحظات (iOS 27، كما راجعناه في 19 نوفمبر 2026). ومن تطبيقات App Store، يذكر Notta وTranskriptor وVerbi العربية بين لغات التفريغ ولها تطبيقات لـ iPhone، ويعمل TurboScribe من المتصفح.

### هل يوجد تطبيق مجاني لتحويل الصوت العربي إلى نص؟

على iPhone يفرّغ WhatsApp الرسائل الصوتية العربية التي تصلك. خطط التطبيقات الأخرى تتغيّر كثيرًا فلا نذكرها هنا؛ راجع صفحة كلٍّ منها. تنزيل Verbi مجاني، وتتضمن الباقة المجانية 60 دقيقة من التفريغ شهريًا وحفظ التسجيلات 15 يومًا و3 ملخصات بالذكاء الاصطناعي شهريًا، دون إنشاء حساب.

### هل يفرّغ Otter اللغة العربية؟

العربية ليست في قائمة اللغات المدعومة في مركز مساعدة Otter (19 نوفمبر 2026). وقد تتغيّر القائمة؛ راجع صفحة Otter.

### هل يفرّغ WhatsApp الرسائل الصوتية بالعربية؟

على iPhone نعم: بحسب مركز مساعدة WhatsApp، العربية ضمن اللغات المدعومة من iOS 16، ويجب تفعيل Siri. وعلى Android تدعم الميزة حاليًا الإنجليزية والبرتغالية والإسبانية والروسية فقط (19 نوفمبر 2026).

### هل يصلني الملخص بالعربية؟

في Verbi نعم، حين تكون واجهة التطبيق بالعربية (منذ الإصدار 1.5.0 على iPhone و1.3.0 على Android): تصلك الملخصات وإجابات الدردشة بلغة التطبيق، ويبقى النص بلغة الكلام.

### من أعدّ هذه المقارنة؟

فريق Verbi. نعتمد في التطبيقات الأخرى على ما تقوله صفحاتها الرسمية ومراكز مساعدتها وصفحاتها في المتاجر فقط؛ وما لا يذكره المصدر نضع مكانه «—».

## المصادر

المعلومات عن التطبيقات الأخرى في هذه الصفحة مأخوذة من صفحاتها الرسمية ومراكز المساعدة وصفحاتها في المتاجر، وقد راجعناها في 19 نوفمبر 2026. وقد تتغيّر مع تحديث التطبيقات.

- Apple: [النسخ النصي في المذكرات الصوتية](https://support.apple.com/ar-sa/guide/iphone/iph00953a982/ios)، [تسجيل الصوت في الملاحظات](https://support.apple.com/ar-sa/guide/iphone/iphbe11247b5/ios)، [تصدير تسجيل](https://support.apple.com/ar-sa/guide/iphone/iph831c37815/ios)
- المسجّلة الذكية من Google: [اللغات والملخصات](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267698?hl=ar)، [الأجهزة](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/16267668?hl=ar)، [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.recorder&hl=ar)
- WhatsApp: [تفريغ الرسائل الصوتية على Android](https://faq.whatsapp.com/241617298315321/?cms_platform=android&locale=ar_AR) و[على iPhone](https://faq.whatsapp.com/241617298315321/?cms_platform=iphone&locale=ar_AR)
- Otter: [اللغات المدعومة](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360047247414-Supported-Languages)، [تطبيق الكمبيوتر](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/35973988280215-Otter-Desktop-App-Mac-Windows)، [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/sa/app/otter-transcribe-voice-notes/id1276437113)، [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aisense.otter&hl=ar) (صفحات المساعدة بالإنجليزية)
